name: Reserpine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States, first in 1977

examples.title: Effect of Intermittent Oro-esophageal Tube Feeding on Severe Traumatic Brain Injury Patients With Tracheostomy

summary: Reserpine was pulled from the market in the United States, starting in 1977 [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, it received a medium risk score of 57 for the liver and a low risk score of 35 for the heart [M]. Additionally, a search found a trial involving tube feeding in severe brain injury patients that listed ethical issues [5].
